question: What placement and salutation formula is indicated for the sage Gaṇaka?
premises: śirasi specifies placement on the head
gaṇaka-ṛṣaye namaḥ gives salutation to the sage
inference: On the head one places obeisance to the sage Gaṇaka, and so forth.
uncertainties: The full sequence of placements is abbreviated by ityādi.
plain_english: On the head: obeisance to the sage Gaṇaka, and so forth.
